name: Kitano Bikumo
source: Mikomo is a prodigy raised by Annie. Some say she actually is her adopted daughter. She is not only intelligent but also well-versed in tactics. However, she can be clumsy in other things. She owns the precious shield aura which gives extra protection to everyone on her side.
